user.title: Connect to ScopeDome Master card
user.description: Enter the card's local IPv4 address and HTTP password. Setup sends read-only commands only.

error.unsupported_status: The response is not the documented Master/Slave protocol layout.

init.title: Step 1 of 2: Verified contacts
init.description: Check the shutter limits and dome Home switch in the ScopeDome driver's Shutters and Sensors tabs at known physical positions. Select each active input value only after verifying it. Set the desired angle on the device's Dome rotation angle control before pressing Left or Right. Encoder pulses per turn are read automatically from the card.

data.home_active_level: Dome Home switch active input (unknown, 0 or 1)

azimuth.title: Step 2 of 2: Azimuth and cloud calibration
azimuth.description: Encoder pulses per turn are read automatically using getCalibratedRotation. Fill the manual fallback only if the card has no valid calibration. Copy 'Home Sensor Position' and the park angle from Config → Dome. Check the raw encoder count and direction at Home. Cloud Index is a threshold in Config → Weather. Leave uncertain fields blank.

data.encoder_direction: Raw count increases during (unknown, CW or CCW)
